question.text: What is the maximum age of information that can be included in the draft offer document or offer document, measured from the issue opening date?

explanation.text: The Logic: Information in the draft offer document or offer document, and particulars from audited financial statements, must not be more than 6 months old from the issue opening date. The Trap: A 12-month period might be confused with annual reporting cycles; SEBI requires a tighter 6-month window to ensure freshness of disclosures from the issue opening date. Note: Audited financial statements have additional timing requirements, including a 120-day rule referenced in the workbook.
